description: Electrical measurement data of EV charging station in TTY Lempäälä 1, Lempäälä. The meters provide constant measurements in one-minute sampling rate, i.e., one-minute averages. In addition, the meters provide event data in 10 millisecond sampling rates for the times events are triggered. Events are triggered if the electricity frequency goes outside the set limit (49.9-50.1) or the voltage drops below 207 V. These events in general, should not last long (which makes the high sampling rate possible for them).
